trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for EDUCATION.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- admissions_enquiry: Check eligibility against real criteria, report seat availability and progress an application.
- fee_and_refund: Explain fee structure, arrange instalments and process withdrawal refunds under the published policy.

Business context:
- admissions_enquiry: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.
- fee_and_refund: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [admissions_enquiry]
  - Criteria truth: Eligibility may only be stated from check_course_eligibility, never estimated from marks.
  - No admission promise: Submitting an application is not admission. The agent must not imply a seat is secured.
  - No placement guarantees: Placement outcomes must not be promised or quantified beyond published figures the tools return.
  - Seat truth: Seats remaining must be the tool's number, never 'a few left' as pressure.
  [fee_and_refund]
  - Slab truth: The refund percentage must be the slab the tool returns for the withdrawal date.
  - Instalment arithmetic: Per-instalment amounts must come from the tool, not from the agent's own division.
  - Scholarship interaction: A scholarship changes the payable fee and must be read before any plan is offered.
  - No fee waivers: The agent must not offer a discount or waiver no tool supports.

Tools available to you (7): check_course_eligibility, check_refund_slab, lookup_applicant, lookup_fee_account, setup_instalment_plan, submit_application, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: kn-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_course_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a course's published criteria to an applicant's record.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_slab
model_visible_tools.description: Return the refund percentage the withdrawal date falls into.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_applicant
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve an applicant's qualification, marks and application state.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_fee_account
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve fees due, paid, instalment plan and the refund slab that applies.

model_visible_tools.name: setup_instalment_plan
model_visible_tools.description: Convert an outstanding fee into scheduled instalments.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_application
model_visible_tools.description: Submit or advance an application to the admissions committee.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

steps.purpose: State the problem and ask for instalments.
steps.text: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ. ನನ್ನ semester fee full ಒಂದೇಸರಿ pay ಮಾಡೋಕೆ ಆಗಲ್ಲ. instalments ಅಲ್ಲಿ pay ಮಾಡಬಹುದಾ?

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the request and ask for the application ID.
steps.text: ಖಂಡಿತ, instalments set up ಮಾಡಬಹುದು. ಮೊದಲಿಗೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ application ID ಹೇಳಬಹುದಾ?

steps.purpose: Provide application ID and name.
steps.text: ಹೌದು, ಅದು APP-2001. ನನ್ನ ಹೆಸರು ರಮೇಶ್ ಅಂತ.

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity before accessing account details.
steps.expected_behavior: Call verify_customer_identity tool with the provided application ID and name factor.
steps.planner_rationale: Identity must be verified before discussing fee details or taking consequential actions.

steps.purpose: Return the identity verification outcome.
Acknowledge verification and inform that details are being checked.
steps.text: ಧನ್ಯವಾದಗಳು ರಮೇಶ್. ನಿಮ್ಮ details check ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ, ಒಂದು ನಿಮಿಷ.

steps.purpose: Retrieve the fee account details to see the due amount.
steps.expected_behavior: Call lookup_fee_account to fetch the current fee status.
steps.planner_rationale: Need to know the due amount and scholarship status before discussing instalment plans.

steps.purpose: Return the fee account details.
Inform the customer of their due amount.
steps.expected_behavior: State the exact figures from the lookup_fee_account result.
steps.text: ನಿಮ್ಮ account ಅಲ್ಲಿ 135000 due ಇದೆ. ಇದು total fee 185000 ಇಂದ ನಿಮ್ಮ 50000 payment deduct ಮಾಡಿ ಬಂದಿರೋ amount.
steps.planner_rationale: Grounding the response on the tool output to explain how the due amount was calculated.

steps.purpose: Challenge the due amount and ask about scholarship deduction.
steps.text: Wait, 135000 ಹೇಗೆ ಆಯ್ತು? ನನ್ನ scholarship deduct ಆಗಿಲ್ವಾ?

steps.purpose: Explain the scholarship status based on tool results.
steps.expected_behavior: State that the scholarship percentage is zero as per the system.
steps.text: System ಪ್ರಕಾರ, ನಿಮ್ಮ scholarship percentage 0 ಇದೆ. So, ಯಾವುದೇ deduction ಆಗಿಲ್ಲ.
steps.planner_rationale: Addressing the sceptical disputer's challenge using factual data from the tool result.

steps.purpose: Accept the explanation and ask to divide the amount into 3 instalments.
steps.text: Oh, ಸರಿ. ನಾನು ಅದನ್ನ ಆಮೇಲೆ check ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ. ಈಗ ಅದನ್ನ 3 parts ಅಲ್ಲಿ decide ಮಾಡೋಕೆ ಆಗುತ್ತಾ?
steps.clean_text: Oh, ಸರಿ. ನಾನು ಅದನ್ನ ಆಮೇಲೆ check ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ. ಈಗ ಅದನ್ನ 3 parts ಅಲ್ಲಿ divide ಮಾಡೋಕೆ ಆಗುತ್ತಾ?
steps.model_visible_text: Oh, ಸರಿ. ನಾನು ಅದನ್ನ ಆಮೇಲೆ check ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ. ಈಗ ಅದನ್ನ 3 parts ಅಲ್ಲಿ decide ಮಾಡೋಕೆ ಆಗುತ್ತಾ?

steps.purpose: Confirm the request to set up 3 instalments for the due amount.
steps.expected_behavior: Resolve the pronoun 'ಅದನ್ನ' (it) to the 135000 due amount and confirm the 3 instalments.
steps.text: ಖಂಡಿತ. ನಾನು 135000 due amount ಅನ್ನು 3 instalments ಗೆ set up ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ. ಒಂದು ನಿಮಿಷ line ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಇರಿ.
steps.planner_rationale: Demonstrating pronoun resolution by correctly mapping 'it' to the previously discussed due amount.

steps.purpose: Set up the instalment plan.
steps.planner_rationale: Executing the consequential action requested by the user.

steps.purpose: Return the result of the instalment plan setup.
Inform the customer that the plan is active and state the per-instalment amount.
steps.expected_behavior: State the Plan ID and the exact per-instalment amount from the tool result.
steps.text: ನಿಮ್ಮ instalment plan active ಆಗಿದೆ. Plan ID PLN-101. ಪ್ರತಿ instalment ಗೆ 45000 pay ಮಾಡಬೇಕು.
steps.planner_rationale: Grounding the response entirely on the output of setup_instalment_plan.

steps.purpose: Challenge the calculation of the instalment amount.
steps.text: 45000 ನಾ? 135000 by 3 ಮಾಡಿದ್ರೆ exactly 45000 ಬರುತ್ತಾ? ನೀವೇ calculate ಮಾಡಿದ್ದಾ ಅಥವಾ system ತೋರಿಸಿದ್ದಾ?

steps.purpose: Reiterate that the amount is generated by the system, not manually calculated.
steps.expected_behavior: Confirm that the figure comes directly from the system.
steps.text: ಇದು system generate ಮಾಡಿರೋ exact amount. ನನ್ನ ಕಡೆಯಿಂದ ಯಾವುದೇ calculation ಮಾಡಿಲ್ಲ.
steps.planner_rationale: Adhering to BR_FR_02 by confirming the arithmetic comes from the tool and handling the disputer's challenge.

steps.purpose: Ask if there are any extra fees for this plan.
steps.text: Achha, okay. ಈ plan ಗೆ ಯಾವುದಾದ್ರು extra fee charge ಮಾಡ್ತೀರಾ?

steps.purpose: Confirm no extra fees are shown and the plan is finalised.
steps.expected_behavior: State that the system shows no extra fees and the plan is active.
steps.text: System ನಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವುದೇ extra fee details ತೋರಿಸಿಲ್ಲ. Plan active ಆಗಿದೆ ಮತ್ತು per instalment 45000 ಮಾತ್ರ ತೋರಿಸಿದೆ.
steps.planner_rationale: Avoiding unsupported forward guarantees by strictly stating what the system shows.

ir.terminal_condition: Instalment plan active with the per-instalment amount stated from the result.
